moments.author: Brendan Carr
moments.quote: Today, in a historic first, the FCC approved SpaceX’s request for 1 million satellites (orbital compute modules) to create data centers in space.
moments.why: Historic approval heralds a new frontier in AI compute infrastructure—space-based data centers reshaping tech and national ambition.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: Much appreciate. This will be a great asset to America and the world.
moments.why: Musk’s response underscores the bold vision behind orbital data centers, sparking massive discussion on tech, AI, and space.

moments.author: Michael Burry
moments.quote: Globally, my portfolio is more long, and less short, than it has been in some time—temporarily almost entirely long.
moments.why: ‘The Big Short’ investor flipping bullish has financial Twitter and markets buzzing about potential AI/tech bubble bottoms.

moments.author: NBA Courtside (via ESPN’s Michael C. Wright)
moments.quote: Some players around the league refer to Victor Wembanyama as ‘Mr. Morality’ or ‘Moral high horse.’
moments.why: A rare behind-the-scenes jab at one of the NBA’s biggest stars—guys 25–45 are all over the moral high ground drama.

moments.author: Major League Baseball (via AP News reporting quotes union)
moments.quote: The lawsuit filed today by MLB is completely frivolous.
moments.why: MLB’s new lawsuit against the players’ union ahead of a looming lockout is lighting up sports-world conversation fast.
